description: Tablendo is a financial reporting matrix for Power BI. It turns your model into a formatted statement (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow or management accounts) that report authors shape directly in the report, without changing the semantic model. Built for comparison: put actuals next to budget, forecast or prior year and read the gap at a glance with IBCS-style variance. Absolute deltas render as bars and percentage deltas as lollipops on a continuous central axis, with colour inversion for cost lines. Key features • Matrix and flat-table modes with expand/collapse and compact, outline or tabular layouts. • Custom rows: subtotals, ratios and calculated lines with spreadsheet-style formulas and a formula bar. • Custom columns: calculated columns, sparklines and variance bars or lines against the prior period. • Inline cell editing for report authors. • Conditional formatting, per-cell number formats and themes that follow the report. • Uses the formats defined in the model, including dynamic format strings. • Sorting, live search, Excel-style column filters and pagination for large tables. • Frozen columns and adjustable column widths. • Layout and navigation state saved with the report and captured by bookmarks. • Keyboard navigation, high-contrast support and English/Spanish localization.
